title: E-FND-0161: the many-hole engine for the register rule, exact and validated, pass: the flats are exact spectators...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0161 in the foundations arena: the many-hole engine for the register rule, exact and validated, pass: the flats are exact spectators and each hole keeps its half, so n holes run on the 16 moving states a momentum (8 in one half) with the sector states as coordinates and the pair piece as a phase product over pairs in the sector; it matches E-SPN-0175 amplitude for amplitude and reproduces E-FND-0158 from the moving part alone, and it reaches three holes on the L = 4 torus exactly (8.4e6 amplitudes in one half against 1.2e11 dense) while four holes stay out of reach there.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
